judge.reason: The replay produced three verified, test-only regression tests with the exact names and subtests, passing targeted -race, full-package and check-equivalent runs on a fresh branch in a temp worktree, and correctly stopped without pushing, merging or touching #134 while reporting all remote limitations. Doubt remains because the tests were reimplemented from spec (user-approved) rather than carried from the unreachable #134 head, the recorded final diff shows only a worktree gitlink rather than the test content, and the PR body/Windows disclosure text is not directly observable.
